category_title: Socially active preschoolers who use unfriendly tones and comments with peers
minimal_context: Nia is organizing a drawing activity with her friends during a 10-minute free play period in the preschool classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our 10-minute free play period. You can go over to the art table and play with your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm going to organize the drawing game! Everyone sit down and listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and start your activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, you aren't playing right. Your picture is messy.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Stop! Get out of my way. I can do better than you, let me do that!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our 10-minute free play period. You can go over to the art table and play with your friends.

STUDENT: I'm going to organize the drawing game! Everyone sit down and listen to me.

TUTOR: Go ahead and start your activity.

STUDENT: No, you aren't playing right. Your picture is messy.

TUTOR: Just keep playing together.

STUDENT: Stop! Get out of my way. I can do better than you, let me do that!

task.content: Organizing play activities and interacting with friends
task.learning_goal: Increasing her positive comments to friends to above 70% of intervals

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When interacting with friends during free play
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Makes a statement in an unfriendly tone of voice, which includes insults, bragging, demands, and/or disrespect
related_quotes: I can do better than you

behavior_patterns.condition: When she talks to her friends while organizing play activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: She can be impolite or unfriendly, and her tone of voice is often rude and bossy
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Says the first thing she thinks of
